name: xray_abdomen
description: Order an abdominal X-ray to evaluate bowel gas pattern, free air, radiopaque foreign bodies, and bony pelvis. First-line for acute abdominal pain and suspected obstruction or perforation.

views.description: Patient position and number of views

clinical_indication.description: Reason for the exam (e.g., abdominal pain, distension, suspected obstruction)

when_to_use: suspected small or large bowel obstruction
evaluation for free air under the diaphragm (perforation)
assessment of fecal loading or constipation
detection of radiopaque foreign bodies or kidney stones

examples.query: Patient presents with colicky abdominal pain, vomiting, and distension
Elderly patient with severe sudden epigastric pain, rigid abdomen
